keywords: Plaintiff-Respondent claimed damages for bodily pain and public humiliation after Defendants-Appellants tied him with a rope, dragged him to a lamppost, and threw red ants at him before a crowd including schoolchildren. The plaintiff\'s evidence was corroborated by his wife and supported by a prompt police statement. District Court accepted the plaintiff\'s version as more probable. Held - found no reason to interfere with the findings based on witness credibility; Appeal dismissed with costs; District Court judgment affirmed.
